reviewer: Project author, after the browser verdict. This is a reading of the patch, not another test.
verdict: Sound, and close to the pending human fix
summary: The Escape keydown handler now runs for modal dialogs too, so with keyboard: false the key is cancelled before Chromium sends a close request that can no longer be cancelled. Pending pull request #43077 makes the same change.
caveats: With keyboard: false the human fix also plays the static-backdrop bounce on each press for modal dialogs; this patch does not.
The cancel handler stays as the fallback for close requests that do not come from a key.
